mechanism.recommended: One non-lossy TargetReadResult tagged union; a shared pure shape validator invoked on pre-read and AGAIN under attach lock after reload. Use membership, exact types and enum domain errors; validate owned target and requested tx, preserve opaque unrelated keys.
mechanism.alternative: Validate all targets on every call: stronger global cleanliness but unrelated malformed data blocks own work and widens scope; not recommended for this owned-key robustness slice.
sequence: Decode exact root JSON; distinguish ENOENT from present invalid/empty/unreadable.
Present root must be dict; target absent tagged; present target must be dict (null not absent).
Requested tx membership separate from its value. Record exact schema; malformed != valid conflicting != matched.
Under _locked reload/revalidate; race from absent/valid to invalid/conflicting returns no write. Atomic append only if allowed absence; never coerce or reset.
After any permitted send actual readback uses same validator; only exact record/bytes may become matched evidence.

questions.why: The lossy {} destroys the fact required to decide whether creation is safe. Shared validation prevents read/attach disagreement and locked revalidation prevents relying on stale pre-read. Independent unknown keys need preservation, not recursive rewriting.

contract_fields.public_error: Expose safe code/stage/effect only inside authorized intent outcome; never raw payload, OS path, foreign key name or invalid type repr. Internal diagnostic may retain enum reason.
contract_fields.tx_schema: record exactly {digest,payload}; payload exactly {tx_id,branch,revision,intent_digest,target_ref}. digest/intents hex64. Equal exact expected is MATCHED; shape-valid different record CONFLICT. Unknown fields in own record require explicit schema-version handling, not silent discard. Other tx/foreign-target values kept opaque; malformed unrelated values not interpreted.
contract_fields.mutation_limits: Error path target file byte-exact unchanged (lockfile creation is a documented synchronization artifact, not target reset). Success may reserialize outer object but semantic unrelated-key equality and prior tx values required. Caller cannot use correction to delete accepted evidence; fixture owner corrects only disposable own malformed key explicitly.

risks: OS-lock only coordinates cooperating simulation writers, not malicious file owner.
Null/scalar/root/record permutations are proposals not observations in current run.
Strict tx record schema migration must fail domain-safe on unknown version, never reset foreign data.

mechanism.alternative: Continue independent YAML after OMH pre-effect invalid target: availability improvement only if independence is proven and global gate rechecked. Needs product approval before becoming guarantee; no such guarantee retroactively belongs to A2.
sequence: Durable attempt precedes action/read. Known validation failure before any new effect records TARGET_INVALID and none_proven_for_attempt; prior ambiguous attempts remain ambiguous.
After send/replace may have happened, any failure is possible-effect/ambiguous. Missing terminal fact after process death is ambiguous, not no-effect.
No successful observation for empty raw error; failure outcome may exist without observation, matched never true.
Return structured SYNC_PENDING and authorized per-intent safe diagnosis; subsequent not-started intents remain pending (optionally skipped_due_to_failure).
New retry starts from exact real pre-read; confirmed old acknowledgements skipped, existing exact target does not write again.
Integrity/storage inability to prove safety aborts fanout regardless of continuation choice.

questions.why: Attempt persistence establishes predecessor, not evidence of external bytes. Outcome certainty is phase-sensitive; catching AttributeError cannot prove rollback after send. Separating failure facts avoids the semantic lie that empty raw is readback and preserves current strong ack binding.

contract_fields.projection: Derived safe IntentStatus extension diagnosis:{code,stage,effect} optional; requested branch only. New status reducer pending/failed-pre-effect vs ambiguous is explicit TD20 delta. No global totals or raw diagnosis.
contract_fields.aggregate: SYNCED iff every required scoped intent has confirmed ack. Any failure/pending/ambiguous -> SYNC_PENDING and ready_for_owner_review=false for sync delivery; trace still applies other existing blockers. Partial YAML ack does not make overall success. CHAIN_BROKEN supersedes aggregate; storage failure remains typed storage error, not fabricated per-intent completion.
contract_fields.continuation_choice: Conservative minimum: stop after typed target error, YAML pending, no false successful observation. Preferred optional robustness: continue YAML iff no declared dependency on failed OMH intent, same authorized branch/revision, healthy global proof before effect and persistence. Per-intent outcomes accurately show partial completion. Choice must be recorded in next TD20 card.
contract_fields.migration: Additive migration only; preserve prior attempts/observations/acks and exact binding. No terminal outcome generated for historical missing completion merely from elapsed time; no rewrite of old ambiguous history.

risks: Current schema has no outcomes table and status makes any attempt ambiguous; new projection requires implementation/migration tests.
One local write under cooperating lock is not universal exactly-once.
Continuing YAML can conflict with future export/OMH dependency policy; fail-stop safe default retained until decision.

mechanism.recommended: Report stores run identity + final manifest byte hash + exact source/input/env linkage + case and receipt locators. Freeze once, write unique run path without overwrite; progress/latest is only navigation.
mechanism.alternative: Content-addressed immutable bundles indexed by hash improve deduplication but add tooling; not necessary to stop mutable-pointer reassignment.
sequence: Allocate unique run directory, capture source/input/environment before run; immutable seed/grants/injection recorded.
Keep progress journal separate; include all failures/incomplete cases and receipts.
Freeze final manifest once under run-specific path, hash exact bytes; store ref/hash outside manifest to avoid circular self-hash.
Resolver checks manifest and each referenced artifact/version hashes; no fallback to latest on missing/mismatch.
Second run gets different path; first report still resolves first bundle/hash even if latest changes.

questions.why: Path plus mutable pointer does not identify historical bytes. Hash+frozen lineage makes reassignment/mismatch detectable without requiring Git. Hash alone is consistency, not trusted timestamp/preregistration or adversarial OS immutability.
